explanation: EXCLURAD computed O(α) QED radiative corrections for eta electroproduction (ep → e'pη) at W=1.5753 GeV, Q²=0.3 GeV², cos(θ*)=-0.527586 with CLAS12 settings (6.53 GeV beam, ν_cut=0.166 GeV²). Results shown for φ*=36°, 72°, 108°. Delta values show the radiative correction factor (σ_obs/σ_Born), while sigma_Born values are in mb.
